headline: FAO forecasts decline in global grain harvest and trade in 2026 | Novini.bg
summary: The Food and Agriculture Organization expects global grain production in 2026 to fall 2.1% from last year, to 2,979 million. Trade is also forecast to decline.
why: Global grain output and trade shape food prices and the outlook for wheat, corn and rice markets.
